scope: Actual Flask url_map with Classic disabled; Hybrid routes indexed with explicit historical and recent control evidence
limitations: Route registration is not a passed functional test; counts refer to evidence records, never page/control coverage percentages
Historical outcomes are preserved, not re-certified against the current code; source files identify revision, isolated/live environment, roles and limits
A control record can cover a partial flow or a specific option; other variants, roles, camera/profile scopes and failure cases remain separate
Records with no unambiguous page/control association require manual mapping; an empty evidence list does not imply missing functionality
Dynamic DOM controls and complete acceptance remain open; Classic physical removal is not certified by this index
Other registered URL paths include authentication, shared/public contracts, assets and navigation redirects; URL naming does not determine ownership or justify deletion
